description: Romantic Gifts '25 — US e-commerce/mail-order + UK non-store retail volume + commercial print / courier / postage cost backdrop + Kalshi Etsy GMS (chart-only). Forums separate.

series.label: Retail Sales: Electronic Shopping and Mail-Order Houses
series.official_name: FRED MRTSSM4541USS — Retail Sales: Electronic Shopping and Mail-Order Houses, SA
series.notes: Census MRTS NAICS 4541 — demand baseline for online personalized gifting (ETSY, FLWS, CMPR).

series.label: RSI Volume SA: Non-store Retailing (All Business)
series.official_name: ONS DRSI J5DZ — Retail Sales Index volume SA, Non-store Retailing, All Business (watch alias GBRRSL02IXOBSAM)
series.notes: ONS Great Britain non-store (online/mail-order) retail volume SA. Demand proxy for Moonpig / Funky Pigeon / Card Factory digital. Watchlists often cite GBRRSL02IXOBSAM (not on FRED).

series.label: PPI: Commercial Printing, Except Screen and Books
series.official_name: FRED PCU32311K32311K — Producer Price Index by Industry: Commercial Printing, Except Screen and Books (watch alias PCU323111323111)
series.notes: Print COGS proxy for cards, photobooks, on-demand gifts (CMPR, CEWE, Moonpig). BLS/FRED industry code is 32311K (not legacy 323111).

series.label: PPI: Couriers and Express Delivery Services
series.official_name: FRED PCU492110492110 — Producer Price Index by Industry: Couriers and Express Delivery Services
series.notes: Parcel / last-mile cost pressure for DTC cards and personalized gifts.

series.label: CPI: Postage and Delivery Services
series.official_name: BLS CUSR0000SEEC01 — CPI-U Postage and Delivery Services, US City Average, SA
series.notes: Stamp / postal tariff friction for physical greeting cards (CARD.LSE, MOON.LSE, ETSY card makers). Not on FRED — BLS only.

series.label: Kalshi — Etsy Q3 marketplace GMS above $2.58B
series.official_name: Kalshi KXETSY-26OCTGMS-2580000000 — Will Etsy report above $2.58B marketplace GMS in Q3 2026?
series.notes: Chart-only prediction market (ETSY). Threshold markets rotate each quarter — retarget ticker when Q3 resolves. Not in backdrop score.
